description: This file defines an abstract class AbstractRecipient within the OrangeHRM.Core.Mail namespace, representing a recipient of an email with methods to retrieve email address and name.

classes.name: AbstractRecipient
classes.description: An abstract class to define the interface for email recipients, requiring implementations of getEmailAddress() and getName() methods.

methods.name: getEmailAddress
methods.description: Abstract method to return the email address of the recipient.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Abstract method to return the full name of the email recipient.
